{{Top|leg}}
'''Swuvehorn''' was a musical instrument that was known to be played on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fegorosk IV]]. It was played in the dank clubs present on the planet, and the atmosphere that was created in these establishments was well-liked enough that it was included in the [[scenic replicator]].
